Epoch rewards shared-memory data structure, partitioning, insertion, hashing, and iteration APIs.

# Purpose
Defines the `fd_epoch_rewards` interface for managing epoch stake reward data in shared memory. The file declares the `fd_epoch_rewards_t` container, the `fd_epoch_stake_reward_t` record type, size and alignment constants, and the maximum partition count used to split rewards across epoch slots. It also declares the functions used to create, join, leave, delete, insert, hash, and query reward partitions, plus an iterator API for walking the stake reward list in each partition.
